payload.summary: The pinned repository (angus924/rocket @ 36bd908b) contains official ROCKET code matching the claim's method: rocket_functions.py implements generate_kernels (random kernels, default 10,000 via the driver) and apply_kernels (PPV and max features per kernel). The UCR driver code/reproduce_experiments_ucr.py loads each dataset's fixed {name}_TRAIN.txt / {name}_TEST.txt split, runs num_runs (default 10) independent kernel draws, fits RidgeClassifierCV(alphas=np.logspace(-3,3,10), normalize=True) on training features, and records classifier.score on the test split; accuracy_mean across runs is the metric written to results_ucr.csv. ECG200 is in the bake-off list (.preprint/reproduce_experiments_bakeoff.py), so the claim's dataset and split correspond to the standard UCR TRAIN/TEST files. The metric is printed/stored only in the CSVs and the script's output; the dataset files are not included in the repo. No dependency file exists in the repository (dependency_discover found none), so the environment must be inferred from README: Python, Numba, NumPy, scikit-learn. The code uses RidgeClassifierCV(normalize=True) and np.int in the .preprint script, which are incompatible with current scikit-learn/NumPy, so an older environment may be needed.

entrypoints.why: Official UCR driver: loads TRAIN/TEST split per dataset, runs 10 ROCKET runs with 10,000 kernels and RidgeClassifierCV, computes accuracy_mean. Arguments: -d dataset list, -i input path, -o output path, -n runs (default 10), -k kernels (default 10,000).
Earlier bake-off version of the same UCR experiment (includes ECG200 in its dataset list); uses np.int and 10**np.linspace alphas.
Core ROCKET implementation: generate_kernels and apply_kernels (Numba-jitted).

payload.runInstructions: Obtain the UCR archive in TXT format (Univariate_arff/ with {name}/{name}_TRAIN.txt and {name}_TEST.txt for ECG200). Create a file listing "ECG200" one per line. Install Python with numba, numpy, pandas, scikit-learn (versions compatible with normalize=True in RidgeClassifierCV, e.g. older scikit-learn). From code/: python reproduce_experiments_ucr.py -d ecg200.txt -i <path>/Univariate_arff -o <output_dir> -n 10 -k 10000. Read accuracy_mean for ECG200 from the output results_ucr.csv. Note the dataset files are not in the repository and no dependency file is pinned.
